description: This PHP file defines the FilterMessageEvent class, which is an event used within the Goteo application to handle message filtering, including setting and retrieving message details and delay status.

classes.name: FilterMessageEvent
classes.description: An event class for filtering messages in the Goteo application, allowing to set and get message details and delay status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event with a Message object.

methods.name: setMessage
methods.description: Sets the message property with a Message object.

methods.name: setDelayed
methods.description: Sets the delayed property, indicating if the message should be sent with delay.

methods.name: getDelayed
methods.description: Retrieves whether the message is set to be delayed.
